bundle.shortDescription: Free screen recorder with auto-zoom, in the style of Screen Studio.
bundle.longDescription: Record a display, a window or an area, then polish the video with auto-zoom on clicks, a smoothed cursor with motion blur, click ripples, backgrounds with rounded corners and shadows, and a camera bubble. Everything stays on your machine: no accounts, no network calls, no telemetry.
